title: Create Semio Elements UI Bundle and Migrate Sketchpad Elements
description: Create a new semio-elements technology with a ui bundle that owns the shared UI elements now living in semio/js/sketchpad. Migrate element exports and imports from sketchpad into semio js, and move the Storybook to the new ui bundle so semio/js consumes the bundle instead of hosting the element source and stories.
summary: Created the new semio-elements technology with a ui bundle, moved the shared sketchpad element source and Storybook into it, rewired semio/js to consume @semio-elements/ui, and extended the existing JS test file to verify the migrated re-export identities. Verified semio/js tests pass and the moved Storybook builds from semio-elements/ui. Full TypeScript preflight still hits pre-existing repository errors in semio/js and the migrated element file.
